name: RNBC New Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: RNBC New Energy Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, and production of thermal management systems in China and internationally. The company offers products related to thermal management of new energy vehicle power batteries, thermal management of gasoline vehicle powertrains, and thermal management of energy storage batteries. Its main products include battery liquid cooling plates, integrated battery boxes, gasoline vehicle engine radiators, heaters, and other housing solutions. Its products are used in various applications, including passenger and commercial vehicles, energy storage and portable power sources, air traffic, construction machinery, and ships.
